author: dqnamo
name: dynamic-button
description: An animated button that smoothly resizes its width to fit new content and crossfades its label and icon whenever the action or state changes. Built with motion/react, it uses a spring width transition, a coordinated vertical fade for content swaps, and an active-press scale. Supports primary and secondary variants, an optional icon, content or full width, and respects reduced-motion preferences.
